note: NOTE: v0.2.7. A Path is an open skill tree a Hero can train. Any Hero can train any path; a skill needs the previous skill in its chain (rank 1+) plus materials. Levels are only a pacing guide for recipe cost: green ~ L5, blue ~ L10, orange ~ L20 (out of scope).

rows.name: Warrior Path
rows.description: Melee: Power Strike at the root, Nature and Elemental branches below.

rows.name: Magician Path
rows.description: Ranged and MP-hungry. Arrives in v0.2.8.
